Chapter 125 - The Sovereign's Might

Linley hovered in the endless chaotic void, staring at the boundless energy circulating around his Sovereign spark.

The wind hummed like a mournful dragon as the Sovereign of Destruction opened his crimson eyes. Thousands of deities bowed across the battlefield.

Deep within the Blood Sun realm, spatial tears opened, revealing ancient artifacts from primordial eras.

Linley took a deep breath, circulating the earthen elemental essence through his supreme god body. The battle had only begun.
